title: The $N$-dimensional gravity driven Muskat problem
summary: We study the Muskat problem, which describes the motion of two immiscible, incompressible fluids in a homogeneous porous medium occupying the full space ${\mathbb{R}^{N+1}}$, $N \geq 2$, driven by gravity. The interface between the fluids is given as graph of a function over $\mathbb{R}^N$. The problem is reformulated as a nonlinear, nonlocal evolution problem for this function, involving singular integrals arising from potential representations of the velocity and pressure fields.
